<div class="soco-joco-intro">

<div class="soco-joco-intro-grid">

<div>

<div class="soco-joco-section-label">
About the Journal
</div>

<h2>
A journal for the cutaneous oncology community.
</h2>

</div>

<div class="soco-joco-intro-copy">

The **Journal of Cutaneous Oncology (JoCO)** is an open-access journal published by the Society of Cutaneous Oncology and dedicated specifically to skin cancer.

JoCO provides a home for scholarship, evidence interpretation, scientific perspective, and discussion across the multidisciplinary cutaneous oncology community.

A central feature of the Journal is **Perspectives on the Science**, a commentary series that examines important publications in their broader clinical and scientific context. Many of these perspectives emerge from discussions in the multi-institutional SoCO Journal Club.

</div>

</div>

From discussion to scholarship
</div>

<h2>
Scientific conversation should continue after the paper is published.
</h2>

<p>
SoCO Journal Club brings clinicians and investigators together to examine emerging evidence, challenge assumptions, and identify the questions that remain. The Journal of Cutaneous Oncology provides a platform for carrying those conversations forward through durable scientific scholarship and perspective.
</p>
